subcategory: Jewel in the Crown of Kashmir & Carved Cedar Houseboats
description: Spanning 18 square kilometers in the Kashmir Valley surrounded by the snow-capped Pir Panjal mountains, celebrated worldwide for intricate carved cedarwood houseboats, shikara water taxis, and floating vegetable markets.
why_visit: Glide silently on a cushioned Shikara over lotus-covered waters, stay overnight in a Victorian-style cedar houseboat, and experience the dawn floating vegetable market in the mist.
best_time_to_visit: April to October (Tulip season in April; frozen or snowy in winter)
activities: Shikara Boat Rides; Houseboat Stay; Floating Market Tour; Sunset Photography; Mughal Garden Visits
notes: Bordered by famous Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi.

subcategory: Verdant Alpine Valley along the Lidder River
description: Originally known as Hajan Valley, renamed after the blockbuster Bollywood film 'Betaab', a picturesque alpine meadow surrounded by snow-clad peaks, pine and deodar forests, and the rushing turquoise waters of the Lidder River.
why_visit: Stroll across manicured emerald meadows framed by dramatic snow peaks, listen to the roaring Lidder River, enjoy pony rides, and have family picnics amidst pristine alpine mountain scenery.
best_time_to_visit: April to October for lush greenery; December to February for snow wonderland
activities: Valley Strolling; Lidder River Photography; Pony Riding; Kashmiri Kahwa Tasting; Snow Sledging
notes: Forms part of the base circuit for the annual Amarnath Yatra pilgrimage.

place_name: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Katra
subcategory: Holy Cave Shrine of the Divine Mother atop Trikuta Mountain
description: Located at 5,200 feet altitude inside a holy cave in the Trikuta Mountains, one of India's most visited Hindu pilgrimage shrines, enshrining the three natural rock pindies of Goddesses Maha Kali, Maha Lakshmi, and Maha Saraswati.
why_visit: Undertake the sacred 12-kilometer trek from Katra to the Holy Cave with thousands of pilgrims chanting 'Jai Mata Di', ride modern electric battery cars or ropeways to Bhairon Temple, and receive Mata's blessings.
activities: Holy Cave Pilgrimage; 12-km Mountain Trek; Bhairon Temple Ropeway Ride; Attending Atka Aarti
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 14 km trek from Katra base / 50 km from Jammu
notes: Mandatory Yatra Parchi registration (online or at Katra station counters) before starting the trek.

subcategory: 6,640-Foot Meadow Resort in the Pir Panjal Range
description: Perched at 6,640 feet (2,024 m) along the Jammu-Srinagar national highway, a charming mountain meadow surrounded by dense cedar and pine forests, famous for paragliding, skiing, and the Skyview Empyrean ropeway.
why_visit: Ride India's highest ropeway (Skyview by Empyrean) soaring 65 meters above pine canopy, walk through lush cedar meadows at Sanasar, and enjoy snow activities in winter.
best_time_to_visit: May to October for pleasant summer meadows; December to March for snow skiing
activities: Skyview Gondola Cable Car; Snow Skiing & Sledging; Pine Forest Walks; Paragliding at Sanasar
notes: Features the 2.8 km long Skyview Gondola connecting Sanget to Patnitop in just 10 minutes.

subcategory: 12,756-Foot Sacred Glacial Cave & Naturally Forming Ice Shiva Lingam
description: Perched at an altitude of 12,756 feet (3,888 m) amidst sheer glacial mountains, a sacred Hindu cave where a natural stalagmite Shiva Lingam forms every summer from freezing water droplets, where Lord Shiva revealed the secret of immortality (Amar Katha) to Parvati.
why_visit: Undertake one of the world's most revered high-altitude pilgrimages, behold the sacred naturally formed ice Shiva lingam, and witness majestic glacial landscapes across Sheshnag Lake and Mahagunas Pass.
best_time_to_visit: July to August during the official 45-day annual Shri Amarnath Yatra
activities: High Altitude Glacier Trek; Ice Lingam Darshan; Helicopter Yatra; Mountain Landscape Photography
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 14 km trek from Baltal / 36 km trek from Chandanwari (Pahalgam)
notes: Compulsory Health Certificate (CHC) and advance shrine board permit registration required.
